notes: scan040.N1: The page starts with the written label (23) and a diagram Z→1, Z→1, then states an equivalence between the topos and the presheaf category of the two-object one-arrow category. No separate authorial page number is visible at the top. The pale bottom foliation is 39.

scan040.N2: The source explicitly underlines est encore, homotopiquement trivial, alors que cette, and fois-ci X ne l’est pas. The rules lie beneath the text and are not cancellations. The F before est encore is not included in that underline.

scan040.N3: The first displayed relation has two waves and a lower straight bar, recorded as approxeq. The two later inline equivalences, X*≃C and V*≃D*, each have one wave and one straight bar and remain simeq. The hatted C in the first display is a simple C with a separate hat; no local font doubt from another page is propagated.

scan040.N4: The singleton is visibly {a}, with a single oval and a short tail. It is preserved even though H reads infinity. The first V carries the written z,Z indices, not indices supplied from the expected geometric application.

scan040.N5: The first V glyph is strongly overtraced, so its exact letterform remains doubtful. The later V in the list has a clear rounded hooked calligraphic shape and is transcribed mathcal V. No conjectural deleted symbol is inserted beneath the first V.

scan040.N6: The parenthesis contains a written equals sign, then a word left as contractibles|contractiles. A first broad line crop did not settle the b/l sequence; one tighter crop r16 was made before that word was decided. It remains open. The equals sign was not expanded to sont.

scan040.N7: The cancelled words after the third F remain doubtful où les. The live replacement qui en sits above them and attaches before principe. The later live insertion néanmoins attaches between pas and le by a curved leader. The leader is not an underline, cancellation or parenthesis.

scan040.N8: The prose fundamental-object symbol is squared capital Pi with index 1. Both K(pi,1) formulas were read individually on r07 and r13; their shorter, curved-foot pi forms remain lowercase. Numeral 1 and comma are present in each K formula.

scan040.N9: Ordinary quotation strokes are written around tenir compte, pièces de construction and morceaux; H’s French guillemets are not on the page. The first opening pair is separated; the latter two openings are compact overlapping marks, with visibly separate closing pairs. C’s quotation convention is retained with medium-confidence opening counts noted.

scan040.N10: The final néc with raised t is clearly present and is not expanded. Its omission in H removes the author’s not-necessarily qualification. The two-stroke sign after de X, is also retained literally instead of expanding it to même.

scan040.N11: Read 22 written baselines, counting the two initial diagram object rows, the two large displayed formulas, and the two insertion baselines separately. Main prose, all handwritten digits and indices, both diagrams, all cancellation sites, insertion attachments and underlines were read visually against both witnesses. The overview and each supplied half were viewed once; 16 crops were inspected. No OCR, outside research, other pages or TeX compilation were used.

scan040.N12. First-pass accounting, retained as history; the final reconciled totals are in the changes summary and this report’s counts object. Three substantive departures from C are proposed: approxeq in the first display; capital Pi in the prose; and calligraphic V at its later, clear occurrence. The added font/word uncertainties, retained C doubts, and foliation macro change do not count as substantive corrections. All five listed C marks remain undecided, each at its own physical occurrence.

scan040.N13. Blind review broadens the cancelled number, the overtraced first V/Z, the short-form shapes, and the contractibility ending. The crossed phrase is provisionally shorthand + si les rather than où les. Both occurrences of the construction noun have the same angular low letters: pierres is favored, with pièces retained as an alternative. The inserted néanmoins and its leader are retained; no final t supports the blind vraiment proposal. The earlier notes describing a definite equals sign or plural adjective must be read with these final qualifications.
